fieldNotes.buildingId: Confirmed Niagara via the 'niagara' wordmark on the building's west/NW face (Street View, captured 2024-12). 450,183 sq ft single-story water-manufacturing plant, established 2018, 3453 S 96th St.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Fenced truck dock yard along the building's north face. Truck access is a driveway off S 96th St on the NW; a small standalone structure sits at the road edge by the entrance.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small (~1-2 vehicle footprint) standalone building sits at the truck-entrance road edge - consistent with a gatehouse/guard booth. Not directly imaged in Street View (limited pano coverage), so classified true at medium confidence and flagged.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False given guardShack inferred true; flagged because the guard-booth call itself is medium confidence.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Continuous canopied dock run along the full ~430 m north face; estimated ~55 doors - band 50+.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Row of marked trailer-parking stalls north of the dock apron holding dozens of dropped trailers; band 25-50.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide dock-yard road and ample paved/desert width at the entrance - room to add an express lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Building sits among large tracts of undeveloped Sonoran desert at the SE edge of Mesa - Rural per the rubric (edge-of-town, sparse surrounding development).
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Edge-of-Mesa-metro location with desert surroundings; cellular coverage probably adequate but lower confidence - flagged. Set false (still within metro reach).
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~28 acres from the perimeter box (building + north dock yard + NW employee parking).
